quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 update note (company outlook; may vary from actual results, which are scheduled for 29 October, 2026; excludes identified items): Integrated Gas production outlook raised to 740 - 780 kboe/d (Q2'26: 631; the earlier QPR outlook of 570 - 630 excluded volumes from ARC Resources and Qatar) and LNG liquefaction volumes 7.2 - 7.6 MT (Q2'26: 7.7; QPR outlook 7.1 - 7.7); the outlook includes the acquisition of ARC Resources, which completed on 2 September, 2026. Upstream production 1,735 - 1,835 kboe/d (Q2'26: 1,824; QPR outlook 1,680 - 1,880); Marketing sales volumes 2,550 - 2,650 kb/d (Q2'26: 2,570; QPR outlook 2,550 - 2,750).
quarterly_data.figure: Integrated Gas production 740 - 780 kboe/d (QPR 570 - 630); LNG liquefaction 7.2 - 7.6 MT; Upstream production 1,735 - 1,835 kboe/d; Marketing sales 2,550 - 2,650 kb/d; ARC Resources acquisition completed 2 September, 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Shell press release: Shell third quarter 2026 update note (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals and Products Q3 2026 outlook: indicative refining margin $42/bbl (Q2'26: $24/bbl) and indicative chemicals margin $208/tonne (Q2'26: $270/tonne); refinery utilisation 93% - 97% (Q2'26: 102%; QPR outlook 93% - 101%), with low Rhine water levels impacting Rheinland refinery utilisation; chemicals utilisation 81% - 85% (Q2'26: 83%). Trading & Optimisation in Chemicals and Products and in Integrated Gas is expected to be in line with Q2'26.

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 cash flow outlook (CFFO): tax paid 3.1 - 3.9, working capital (4) - 1 ($ billions); CFFO excluding working capital is expected to include an ~$2.5 billion outflow related to timing of payments of emissions certificates relating to the German BEHG (Fuel Emissions Trading Act, historically paid in the 4th quarter), and a $0.8 billion JV dividend inflow offset by a $0.8 billion outflow through working capital (net impact on CFFO zero). Net debt will be impacted by the ARC acquisition cash consideration and assumption of debt and an increase in variable components of long-term shipping leases.
